project_identity.name: Tethran
project_identity.description: Enforceable, traceable, deliverable payments for Africa's freelancers and agencies: milestone escrow in USDT, an untrusted AI Settlement Agent, a Policy Service with an on-chain spending guard, mobile-money style payouts and NFT receipts. Built for the W3Node Node Engine Hackathon 2026, Mobile Money & Peer-to-Peer track (Tether).
project_identity.architecture_summary: Three-way separation: the Settlement Agent (LLM) proposes, a deterministic Policy Service authorises and co-signs, and contracts enforce (USDT milestone escrow, 2-of-2 vault with spending guard, soulbound receipt NFT). All chain access goes through a ChainClient interface with per-chain config. Fiat-to-USDT conversion, identity checks and payout rails are simulated and labelled.
